title: Fixed an issue where a custom `noWordWrapClassName` replaced the built-in `htNoWrap` class, so cells still wrapped their content with `wordWrap: false`. Handsontable now always adds `htNoWrap` next to your class. To set another `white-space` value, use a selector stronger than `.handsontable .htNoWrap`, for example `.handsontable td.yourClass`.
